mapper.select: SELECT sb.id, sb.batch_code, sb.batch_name, sb.batch_status, sb.selection_mode, sb.separate_student_categories, sb.questionnaire_version_id, sb.matching_weight_scheme_id, sb.rule_template_id, sb.start_at, sb.end_at, sb.hold_duration_seconds, sb.hold_renewal_limit, sb.allow_team, sb.team_min_size, sb.team_max_size, sb.allow_student_random, sb.unselected_strategy, sb.rule_version, sb.created_by, sb.published_at, sb.finished_at, sb.version, sb.created_at, sb.updated_at, COALESCE(eligibility.eligible_count, 0) AS eligible_count, COALESCE(bed_results.bed_assigned_count, 0) AS assigned_count, COALESCE(bed_results.bed_assigned_count, 0) AS bed_assigned_count, COALESCE(room_results.room_assigned_count, 0) AS room_assigned_count, COALESCE(room_locks.locked_room_count, 0) AS locked_room_count, COALESCE(room_results.unconfirmed_bed_resident_count, 0) AS unconfirmed_bed_resident_count FROM selection_batch sb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, COUNT(*) AS eligible_count FROM batch_student_eligibility WHERE eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE' GROUP BY batch_id ) eligibility ON eligibility.batch_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, COUNT(*) AS bed_assigned_count FROM bed_assignment GROUP BY batch_id ) bed_results ON bed_results.batch_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, COUNT(*) AS room_assigned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND bed_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconfirmed_bed_resident_count FROM room_assignment WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY batch_id ) room_results ON room_results.batch_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, COUNT(*) AS locked_room_count FROM active_batch_room_lock GROUP BY batch_id ) room_locks ON room_locks.batch_id = sb.id ORDER BY sb.created_at DESC, sb.id DESC
